definitions.gloss: to finish a race; to run the entire course; to complete a race
definitions.explanation: To run or complete a race from start to finish, especially a long-distance race like a marathon. Can also be used figuratively for completing something challenging from beginning to end.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完走|かんそう}した。
⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧フルマラソン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{完走|かんそう}→完走：16981_kansou⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I'm happy that I was able to finish my first full marathon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}めた→痛める：13613_itameru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{完走|かんそう}すること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I hurt my leg partway through, but I managed to finish the race.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{完走|かんそう}→完走：16981_kansou⟧ emphasizes completing the full distance rather than winning. It is a significant achievement in long-distance events like marathons, triathlons, and ultramarathons. Also used figuratively for completing a long project or series.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完走|かんそう}する (to finish a marathon)
- ⟦{完走|かんそう}→完走：16981_kansou⟧⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (finisher)
- ⟦{完走|かんそう}→完走：16981_kansou⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (completion rate)
- ⟦{完走|かんそう}→完走：16981_kansou⟧⟦タイム→タイム：23539_taimu⟧ (finishing time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完走|かんそう}→完走：16981_kansou⟧: completion of a race (noun form)
- ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reach the goal, to finish
- リタイア⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to retire, to drop out (antonym)
